name: codetags-local
description: Claude Code plugins for working on codetags itself, enabled only in this repository (PLAN.md D18).

plugins.name: codetags-lsp
plugins.description: rust-analyzer shared through lspmux, with Claude Code as an agent session of the codetags shim (M3, docs/lsp-shim.md).

plugins.name: codetags-lsp-recorder
plugins.description: rust-analyzer through codetags-lsp record, which logs every LSP message (M3 stage 0, docs/lsp-stage0.md). Off by default; the stage-0 test loads it with --plugin-dir.
